notes: The original contents/verified facts in M10 cards.js were retained verbatim before the appended M10.2 extension block.
Source-URL facts from the supplied JSON were not rechecked during this pass, by request. Their original URL/label is retained.
Items without a claim-specific URL were either tied to an official source URL shown in sourcesUsed or retained as Review.
All source-less or conflicting State Animal candidates are kept out of the scored animal quiz. The existing M10 animal is not overwritten.
The original separated files remain in use: js/data/cards.js for verified claims; js/data/cards-dk.js for Review-only claims.
This source audit is documentation only; it is not loaded as a runtime data bank.
